text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 4632100000: Increased p99 latency and dropped throughput for runtime service 'runtime-usw2' after release-2026-03-17. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.
oncall-alice: Ack. I'm on it. Pulling graphs.
oncall-alice: Initial: p50 ok, p95 ~200ms↑, p99 1.8s↑, throughput -30% in last 5m. Canary traffic shows sawtooth spikes.
eng-bob: I'm looking. Saw rollout toggled feature flag 'prefetch_v2' to on at 22:15 UTC. Investigating kernel fallback logs.
infra-carlos: Logs show kernel fallback to legacy-kernel-2 on some nodes. Example from pod runtime-abc123:
```
[WARN] kernel_fallback: selected legacy-kernel-2 due to missing optimized kernels for new op fused_attn
latency_ms=1845
```
sre-dana: Batching metrics: average batch size spiked from 8->32 on canary nodes, increasing tail latency. Likely batching window config mismatch with new scheduler.
oncall-alice: @eng-bob can we flip kill-switch for feature flag? Need to stop rollout and cut to stable.
eng-bob: Attempting quick kill: `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood.internal/flags/prefetch_v2/kill` -> 202 Accepted. Rolling back canary to 2026-03-17-0.9.2.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollback job started job-id=rb-4632100000, targeting canary slice 3/5.
pm-erin: Heads up: support reported 2 customers with higher latencies. @support-frank can you confirm impact and CS messaging?
support-frank: Confirmed. Customer A (acme-corp) saw timeout spikes; Customer B (shopify-qa) saw degraded throughput. Sending template: 'We're rolling back an experimental change, should be resolved in ~10m'.
infra-carlos: Rollback completed on 3/5 canary nodes. Kernel fallback events decreased. Metrics starting to normalize on those nodes.
sre-dana: p99 down to 420ms on rolled-back nodes, global p99 still 900ms due to remaining canary shards.
eng-bob: Investigating root cause: prefetch_v2 scheduler occasionally opens batch window longer when KV cache misses high -> batches grow, causing longer attention kernels to run, some model variants lacking optimized kernels trigger fallback path.
oncall-alice: Next steps: 1) keep kill-switch until validated 10m stable, 2) collect minimal repro, 3) ensure rollback fully rolled to all canary slices, 4) follow up postmortem.
eng-bob: I'll instrument extra logs and a targeted test harness. Patch idea: add hard cap on batch window when prefetch_v2 enabled.
pm-erin: I'll notify affected customers and track SLAs.
support-frank: Notifying account teams, will collect CS tickets.
oncall-alice: Thanks team. Marking incident ongoing->mitigated in 10m if metrics stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 4632100000: mitigation in progress. Runbook link https://kb.redwood.internal/incidents/4632100000
